overview_description.description:
DISCO is a legal technology company that applies artificial intelligence and cloud computing to legal problems to help lawyers and legal teams improve legal outcomes for clients. Corporate legal departments, law firms, and government agencies around the world use DISCO as an e-discovery solution for compliance, disputes, and investigations. The company is reinventing legal technology to automate and simplify complex and error-prone tasks that distract from practicing law.

DISCO was founded in 2012 and is based in Austin, Texas.

about_short_description.short_description: DISCO is a legaltech company that applies AI and cloud computing to legal problems to help lawyers and legal teams improve legal outcomes.

product.name: DISCO Platform
product.description: A cloud-based legal technology platform that combines eDiscovery, legal AI, case preparation, document review, timelines, legal holds, and data requests.

product.name: DISCO Ediscovery
product.description: Cloud-native eDiscovery software for searching, analyzing, reviewing, and producing large volumes of legal data during litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters.

product.name: Cecilia AI
product.description: An AI toolset for legal fact investigation, document analysis, and question answering across case materials, with cited answers and lawyer-oriented workflows.

product.name: DISCO Hold
product.description: A cloud-based legal hold system for preserving data, notifying custodians, tracking acknowledgments, and maintaining a defensible audit trail.

product.name: Auto Review
product.description: Generative AI-powered document review software that helps legal teams classify and analyze documents at scale during eDiscovery and investigations.

product.name: Case Builder
product.description: A cloud-based case strategy and deposition management platform for preparing cases, reviewing testimony, creating annotations, and organizing deposition materials.
